activityStatementProfile.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS messages, COUNT(DISTINCT m.author_id) AS authors,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.edited_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS editedMessages,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN trim(m.content, char(9) || char(10) || char(13) || ' ') != '' THEN 1 END) AS textMessages,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archive_attachments a WHERE a.message_id = m.id) THEN 1 END) AS attachmentMessages, MIN(m.ts) AS firstTs, MAX(m.ts) AS lastTs
    FROM archive_messages m WHERE 1 AND m.channel_id IN (SELECT ? UNION ALL SELECT id FROM archive_all_channels WHERE is_thread = 1 AND parent_id = ?)

WITH RECURSIVE months(start) AS (
    SELECT date(? / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', 'start of month')
    UNION ALL SELECT date(start, '+1 month') FROM months WHERE start < date(? / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', 'start of month')
  ) SELECT start FROM months

limits: Five uncached reads exceed the 100 ms budget; exact repeated reads meet it.
New query, rollup revision, privacy or zone changes invalidate cached answers.
Builds and dirty snapshots use live background worker folds.
Visible channel/server references require live folding; conversations fold the channel for adjacency.
A rebuild cannot restore retention-pruned text.
Conversation ranges select runs by their opener timestamp.
Real-archive, encrypted and renderer timings remain unverified.
